Replenishing Night Cream Age Defense 50ml e 1.69 US Fl.Oz. Boosts radiance, replenishes and reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles in 4 weeks. The unique anti-aging complex includes provitamin A and targeted hyaluronic acid to deeply hydrate while anti-oxidants C and E protect. Plant stem technology works to enhance skin's radiance. Directions: Use every evening after cleansing. Warnings: Avoid direct contact with eyes. If product gets into the eyes rinse with water immediately. Colour may vary due to natural ingredients.
